root_cause: Package-resident validators were invoked before the package commit was present in the preserved implementation branch.
bootstrap_protocol: obtain one exact package commit SHA from the publication receipt and verify the moving branch still equals it
extract the bootstrap-v2 runner and validator from that exact commit with git show
verify the exact bootstrap and required package file set directly from the Git object database
validate the package in a detached temporary worktree before mutating local history
merge the exact package commit with preserved fresh-review head as first parent
run post-merge supplement authority and hostile-fixture checks
integrity_model: The externally pinned 40-hex Git commit and its recursively hashed Git tree are the byte authority. The validator emits an aggregate SHA-256 over the sorted bootstrap path/byte pairs for the handback, but does not depend on a self-referential package manifest.
prohibited: source mutation before all pre-repair markers
branch merge or reset by Codex
moving-ref merge without an exact external SHA pin
campaign rerun without solver-semantic or numerical-payload change
production activation, timing, speedup, BDF ranking, tag, release, or merge
